summary: Map kit: drop 22 non-needed creatures from the creature atlas
author: pm
body:
The map kit's creature atlas (HH-0048) holds 70 creatures. The user ruled that 22 of them are not needed in the kit (2026-11-24): "dummy, arrow_guard_tower, cannon_guard_tower, mana_collector, detector, energy_shield, grand_magic_generator, mana_stone, light_war_beetle, gods_hand_knight, gods_hand_knight_ck, temple_knight, battle_golem, catapult, abaddon, sorceress, template_knight_atk, master_elf, dark_knight, helbreath_tank, crusade_barricade_turrent, apocalypse_cannon ... Those are not needed in the minimap kit". "template_knight_atk" is read as `temple_knight_atk` and "crusade_barricade_turrent" as `crusade_barricade_turret`, which are the atlas names.

**Done when:** `build_kit.py` excludes the 22, and the rebuilt `creatures.png/json` and every `placements.json` hold the remaining 48 and none of the 22.

Source: user message, 2026-11-24; atlas list in `.claude/scratch/mapkit_agent/creatures_contact.png`.

**Verified, 2026-11-24:** I rebuilt the kit with `NOT_IN_KIT`. `creatures.json` now has 48 entries and none of the 22. In all 79 placements, none of the 105 creature references is excluded (checked by script and by the reviewer). No `ink.png` changed. The read-only review passed. Committed as bbc5b1a.
